summary: Columbia Financial, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an Agency Agreement with Keefe Bruyette Woods, Inc. to assist in selling shares of common stock in subscription and community offerings and to act as lead-left book running manager for any firm commitment underwritten offering. The filing details fee structures based on aggregate purchase price and offering type. This is a routine engagement of an underwriter/agent for an IPO or secondary offering, not a special situation event. No terms such as price per share, premium, or close date are stated. The filing describes a standard capital markets engagement.
